issues.title: Truncated Context / Missing Sub-modules
issues.why: The spec relies heavily on sub-folders (02-error-architecture, 03-error-code-registry) which are referenced as canonical but are truncated in the provided 120KB context.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of 02-error-architecture/ and 03-error-code-registry/ to resolve core implementation logic for AppError and the Registry.

issues.title: Concurrency in Registry Scripts
issues.why: The spec mentions collision resolution and registry scripts but does not define how the 'error-codes-master.json' handles concurrent CI writes or locking.
issues.fix: Add a concurrency section to 03-error-code-registry/00-overview.md specifying a 'last-writer-wins' or 'CI-lock' policy.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'identifier' in Fallback Flow
issues.why: AC-07 and Retrospective 04 mention a fallback to WP Core API using '{identifier}', but don't specify if this is the numeric ID or the string slug.
issues.fix: Explicitly define 'identifier' as the 'plugin-folder/plugin-file.php' string in 01-error-resolution/03-retrospectives/04-activation-endpoint-mismatch.md.
